'''[[w:India|India]]''' is a large country in [[South Asia]]. It is the world's most populous nation and a land of great diversity, with snowy Himalayan peaks, tropical beaches, deserts and some of the oldest cities on Earth.

==Cities==
* {{marker|type=city|name=[[Delhi]]|lat=28.6100|long=77.2300|wikidata=Q1353}} — the capital, with Mughal monuments and the old city
* {{marker|type=city|name=[[Mumbai]]|lat=19.0761|long=72.8775|wikidata=Q1156}} — India's biggest city and home of Bollywood
* {{marker|type=city|name=[[Jaipur]]|lat=26.9260|long=75.8235|wikidata=Q66485}} — the Pink City of palaces and forts
* {{marker|type=city|name=[[Hyderabad (India)|Hyderabad]]|lat=17.3617|long=78.4747|wikidata=Q1361}} — Charminar, biryani and pearls
* {{marker|type=city|name=[[Varanasi]]|lat=25.3176|long=82.9739}} — the holy city on the Ganges

==Other destinations==
* [[Taj Mahal]] — the white-marble mausoleum in [[Agra]]
* {{marker|type=vicinity|name=[[Ladakh]]|lat=34.15|long=77.58}} — high-altitude desert with Buddhist monasteries

==Understand==
India has a long history.
